automation.name: EOS A/B Upgrade — Single Device
automation.description: Generic, reusable per-side subworkflow: GSHUT drain and confirm convergence, then stage/activate/reload the target image. Called twice by the orchestrator, once per side, with `side` as an input rather than duplicating this workflow. Task graph is a scaffold pending task wiring at Build time — see docs/itential-task-map.md, services/eos_upgrade/maintenance.py, and services/eos_upgrade/upgrade.py.

device.description: Hostname/inventory identifier of the side being upgraded

peer_device.description: Hostname/inventory identifier of the other side, now carrying full traffic
